name: Spirit Master’s Channel
body:
Your devotion empowered your dominion over life energy.

Prerequisite(s): Divine touch Ni class feature, 4th level character.

Benefits: You may expend 2 uses of your divine touch ability to channel energy as a warpriest of your same level.
